title: FBI-UAP-PR005, Digital Recreation, Narrative Statement 3-1, Western United States Event, 2023
what_is_it: A video: a computer-generated digital recreation (artistic reconstruction) of a reported UAP incident, prepared by the FBI for the Department of War.
interpretation_warnings: No PDF/OCR text was extractable; all facts here derive from war.gov catalogue metadata, not from the video content itself.
This is an artistic interpretation / digital recreation, not primary sensor footage — its imagery is an illustrator's reconstruction, not direct evidence of what occurred.

Single-source account: the recreation rests on the description of one federal law enforcement special agent (via DOW-UAP-D081); the observation is unverified by independent instrumentation in this record.
Prepared in 2026, roughly three years after the reported October 2023 event, which introduces recall and reconstruction distance.
The specific site is described only as a 'sensitive national security site' and is not named, limiting independent verification of location.
